content: For a Vite + React static/SPA site, both Vercel and Netlify support it well with near-identical zero-config setup (build: npm run build, output: dist, SPA fallback rewrite to index.html). Vercel is more polished for React-specific DX (preview URLs, faster cold starts) while Netlify is more framework-agnostic and bundles form handling/identity features many static portfolio sites otherwise pay for. For a static portfolio with a serverless contact-form function (e.g. Resend), Vercel's /api routes (Vercel Functions) or Netlify Functions both work; either is a fine default.
